name: Raisin
overview: Scripture highlights the raisin as a meaningful provision in times of need and hospitality, notably included in gifts to David by Abigail and Ziba, symbolizing sustenance and care. At Ziklag, raisins accompanied bread and other foods, underscoring their role in nourishment during journeys and recovery, as seen when given to the famishing Egyptian to revive him after prolonged fasting. These instances reflect God's provision and the faithfulness of His servants in meeting physical needs with thoughtful gifts.
